encrypted.description: True if the card number is encrypted

approvalCode.description: Approval code that can be used for reference

interacMacResult.description: Interac mac result (if interacMac is used)

sourceType.description: Discriminator field representing the type of Funding source

interacMac.description: Interac mac details for canada based cards

interacMacKSN.description: Interac mac key serial number for canada based cards

externalProcessor.description: Processor that has already processed this payment externally
